source.description: Where it came from e.g. Sarvesh Ch.4, CAT 2023 S2, Cracku Sectional 3

topic.description: Topic within QA — the axis the heatmap is built on

area.description: Parent area. Arithmetic is ~40% of the section.

confidence.description: Intuition rating at the 15-second evaluate step, BEFORE solving. Vault taxonomy.

time_seconds.description: Time spent in seconds. Over 180s on a wrong answer is an 'ego question'.

error_type.description: Primary reason it went wrong — each needs a different fix

notes.description: The shortcut, formula or approach that was missed
